# Marcher engine (vendored)

Marcher is an MIT-licensed English-checkers engine by Collin Kees: https://github.com/Stermere/Checkers-Engine
(engine commit 1fa785e, 15 August 2026). These two files are its published SIMD WebAssembly build, downloaded from
https://stermere.github.io/Marcher_Engine_GUI/engine/ and pinned by SHA256SUMS. `pnpm fetch:marcher` re-downloads
and verifies them. The license text is in LICENSE and must be kept with the files.
